# Breadcrumb: `jl-breadcrumb`

Where a page sits in a hierarchy: a trail of links that ends with the current page.

- Class `JlBreadcrumb`, a molecule: `import { JlBreadcrumb } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/breadcrumb

A trail from the top of a hierarchy to the page people are on. Each item is { label, href?, icon? }:
an item with an href is a link, the others plain text; the last item is the current page and is marked so for screen
readers.

With max, a trail longer than that keeps its first item and its last ones, and folds the middle into a … button;
pressing it unfolds the trail and moves the focus to the first item it showed. Long labels are cut with an ellipsis and
show whole on hover.

## Use

```ts
import { JlBreadcrumb } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlBreadcrumb
  items={[{"label":"Home","href":"#/","icon":"house"},{"label":"Acme","href":"#/"},{"label":"Engineering","href":"#/"},{"label":"Platform","href":"#/"},{"label":"Payments API","href":"#/"},{"label":"Deployments"}]}
  max={4}
/>
```

```html
<jl-breadcrumb
  items='[{"label":"Home","href":"#/","icon":"house"},{"label":"Acme","href":"#/"},{"label":"Engineering","href":"#/"},{"label":"Platform","href":"#/"},{"label":"Payments API","href":"#/"},{"label":"Deployments"}]'
  max="4"
></jl-breadcrumb>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `items` (attribute `items`): `BreadcrumbItem[]`, default `[]`. The trail, from the top: { label, href?, id?, icon? }. An item with an id and no href fires select. The last item is the current page.
- `max` (attribute `max`): `number`, default `0`. The most items shown before the middle folds into a … button; 0 never folds.
- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The navigation’s name for screen readers. Empty: jlib's own text, in the language shown.

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `select` (`onSelect` in JSX), detail `Id`: An item with an id and no href was followed: the app goes there itself (a router’s goto).

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The nav element around the trail.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Followed by the app

Items with an id instead of an href: the app follows them, as a router would with goto.

```html
<div class="stack">
  <jl-breadcrumb class="demo-routed" items='[{"label":"Orders","id":"orders"},{"label":"Order #3","id":"order"},{"label":"Lines"}]'></jl-breadcrumb>
  <span class="muted demo-routed-note">Nothing followed yet</span>
</div>
```

```js
root.querySelector('.demo-routed').events.register('select', (id) => {
  root.querySelector('.demo-routed-note').textContent = 'Followed: ' + id;
});
```

### A trail

```html
<jl-breadcrumb items='[{"label":"Home","href":"#/","icon":"house"},{"label":"Projects","href":"#/components"},{"label":"Website"},{"label":"Settings"}]'></jl-breadcrumb>
```

### Folded in the middle

max="4": the first item, the … button, and the last three.

```html
<jl-breadcrumb max="4" items='[{"label":"Home","href":"#/","icon":"house"},{"label":"Acme","href":"#/"},{"label":"Engineering","href":"#/"},{"label":"Platform","href":"#/"},{"label":"Payments API","href":"#/"},{"label":"Deployments"}]'></jl-breadcrumb>
```

### Over a page title

Over a page title, the trail says where the page sits.

```html
<div class="stack">
  <jl-breadcrumb items='[{"label":"Billing","href":"#/"},{"label":"Invoices","href":"#/"},{"label":"INV-2041"}]'></jl-breadcrumb>
  <div class="row">
    <strong>Invoice INV-2041</strong>
    <jl-button size="sm" icon="download" label="Download PDF"></jl-button>
  </div>
</div>
```
